name: Square Root Decomposition
statement:
You are given a list of N numbers and Q queries.Each query is specified by two numbers i and j.The answer to
each query is the minimum number between the range between i and j(including i and j).The query are specified using 0 based indexing.

Expected complexity : O(Q * logN)
inputFormat: The first line contains N. The next line holds N numbers. Following the list is a number Q. The next Q lines each contain two numbers i and j which specify a query you must answer.
outputFormat: For each query, output the Minimum in the range in a line.
